name: Coyote Payday
tagline: Payroll for people who'd rather be shooting than doing math at 2am.
positioning: Run legit film payroll for your crew without hiring a payroll company or reading a single IRS pamphlet cover to cover.

hero.h1: Film payroll that doesn't need a producer's note to explain it.
hero.sub: Pay your grips, gaffers, and that one PA who ran on 4 hours of sleep — with timecards, taxes, and W-2s handled. You keep the coffee budget.

features.title: Timecards that survive a 14-hour day
features.description: Crew clocks in from set on their phones. Meal penalties, turnaround, and overtime calculate themselves so you're not doing multiplication on a call sheet.

features.title: Taxes filed without the panic
features.description: We register your production, withhold correctly across states, and file quarterly. When someone asks about your FEIN, you'll actually have an answer.

features.title: W-2s and 1099s, sorted
features.description: Loan-outs, day players, and box rentals all end up in the right bucket. Come January nobody emails you angry.

features.title: Deal memos to direct deposit
features.description: Attach the deal memo, set the rate, and every paycheck matches what you promised. No 'wait, was that scale plus ten?' arguments.

features.title: Union-friendly, or not
features.description: Non-union shorts to SAG-AFTRA features — pick your framework and we handle the fringe math instead of you guessing.

features.title: One dashboard for every gig
features.description: Juggling three projects at once? Each production stays separate, but the payroll lives in one login you'll actually remember.

testimonials.quote: I used to spend the wrap party doing timecards in a spreadsheet. Now I do the wrap party at the wrap party. Coyote pays my crew before I've even loaded out.
testimonials.name: Dara Whitlock

testimonials.quote: My accountant stopped screaming at me. Loan-outs, mileage, kit fees — it just files correctly. That's the whole review.
testimonials.name: Marcus Ferro

testimonials.quote: We shot in three states in six weeks. I did not read a single tax form. Ten out of ten, would panic less again.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

pricing.blurb: For one-off shorts, spec spots, and passion projects with a small crew.
For working producers running back-to-back gigs all year.
For prod companies with a slate and a real accountant to impress.

homepage.footerBlurb: Coyote Payday runs payroll for indie film crews so you can spend your energy on the shot, not the spreadsheet.
